pr_title: privilege: Add REFERENCES privilege on db/schema and table level.
pr_body:
<!-- Thank you for contributing to TiDB!

PR Title Format:
1. pkg [, pkg2, pkg3]: what's changed
2. *: what's changed

-->

### What problem does this PR solve?

Issue Number: close #26703 

Problem Summary:
REFERENCES privilege was not accepted on DB/Schema or Table level, as in MySQL.

### What is changed and how it works?

What's Changed:
Added `ReferencesPriv` to `AllDBPrivs` and `AllTablePrivs` in https://github.com/pingcap/parser/pull/1304
and added `References_priv` here in `sqlLoadDBTable`

How it Works:
By including ReferencesPriv also on DB/Schema and Table level (was already on Global level) it is now compatible with MySQL.

### Check List <!--REMOVE the items that are not applicable-->

Tests <!-- At least one of them must be included. -->

- [X] Unit test
- [X] Integration test
- [ ] Manual test (add detailed scripts or steps below)
- [ ] No code

Side effects

- [ ] Performance regression: Consumes more CPU
- [ ] Performance regression: Consumes more Memory
- [X] Breaking backward compatibility: `GRANT ALL PRIVILEGES` on DB/Schema and Table level will now include References privilege, which also means that if `GRANT ALL PRIVILEGES` was given before this patch, `SHOW GRANTS` will no longer show `GRANT ALL PRIVILEGES` but instead the full list except REFERENCES privilege.

Documentation

- [ ] Affects user behaviors
- [ ] Contains syntax changes
- [ ] Contains variable changes
- [ ] Contains experimental features
- [ ] Changes MySQL compatibility

### Release note <!-- bugfixes or new feature need a release note -->

```release-note
Included REFERENCES privilege in DB/Schema and Table level grants, which also affects GRANT ALL PRIVILEGES on those levels.
```
